allow: Bash(python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert\(0,''\); from handlers.process_handler import load_prompt")
Bash(powershell -Command '$d = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; New-BurntToastNotification -Text "Claude Code", \("허가 대기 중: " + $d.tool_name\) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0')

hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); print(f,end='')" | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.py$' && python -m black "$f" && python -m isort "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
